name: Restar Corporation
summary: Restar Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors, electronic components, image sensors, cameras, peripheral equipment, and related products in Japan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Devices Business Unit, System Business Unit, and IT&SIer Business Unit segments.
